title: Head of Quality
text:
**Head of Site Quality**

**New Jersey, USA | On-site | Dechra Pharmaceuticals**

This is a rare opportunity to shape the quality strategy, expansion and future of a world-class sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing site.

As Head of Site Quality, you will provide strategic leadership across Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Microbiology and Quality Systems for a growing manufacturing operation producing biologic monoclonal antibodies and sterile pharmaceutical products for global markets. You will play a pivotal role in driving quality strategy, regulatory compliance, operational excellence and site expansion.

We're seeking an inspiring quality leader who can combine deep technical expertise with strong commercial awareness, building high-performing teams while maintaining the highest standards of compliance in a complex GMP environment.

**The Opportunity**

You will:

Lead all site quality functions, including QA, QC, Microbiology and Quality Systems.

Own inspection readiness and lead interactions with FDA, USDA and international regulatory authorities.

Provide quality leadership across aseptic manufacturing, sterilisation, lyophilisation and packaging operations.

Drive a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and operational excellence.

Partner with senior stakeholders across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and Technical Operations.

Support site expansion, technology transfer activities and future biologics capabilities.

**What We're Looking For**

You will be an experienced pharmaceutical quality leader with a proven track record in aseptic manufacturing environments and a passion for developing people and building quality cultures.

**Key requirements include:**

Significant technical QA experience within pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical quality.

Significant leadership experience in **aseptic manufacturing** operations.

Deep knowledge of GMP, aseptic processing and contamination control strategies.

Knowledge of isolator fillers would be desirable but not essential.

Experience leading FDA and EU inspections with successful outcomes.

Expertise across quality systems, batch disposition, deviation management and regulatory compliance.

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

Degree qualified in Pharmacy, Biological Sciences, Microbiology, Chemistry, Engineering or a related discipline.

**Why Join Dechra?**

At Dechra, we're driven by a shared purpose of supporting animal health worldwide. You'll join a business where quality is fundamental to success, where investment in people is a priority, and where you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on a strategically important manufacturing site.

If you're ready to lead quality for a complex sterile manufacturing operation and help shape a new site and the next phase of our growth, we'd love to hear from you!
